# `catchToOrElseSucceed`

Suggests using Effect.orElseSucceed instead of Effect.catch + Effect.succeed

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377095` |
| Language Service name | `catchToOrElseSucceed` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/catch-to-or-else-succeed` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

export const program = Effect.fail("error").pipe(
  Effect.catch(() => Effect.succeed(42))
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(catch-to-or-else-succeed): `Effect.orElseSucceed` expresses the same recovery more directly than `Effect.catch` followed by `Effect.succeed`.
*/
)
```

      }
    ]

}
